instanceAddon.poolNameHint: What luna files it under. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _.
instanceAddon.platformHint: Which ecosystem the build is for; it decides the directory it lands in.
instanceAddon.duplicateTitle: {instance} already has this addon under another name:
instanceAddon.replaceOn: The old copy is removed once the new one is in place, so the server loads it once.
instanceAddon.replaceOff: Both copies will sit in the directory and the server will try to load the addon twice.
instanceAddon.restartNote: The addon is pooled either way. A running server loads it on its next restart.
